navigate_to_goal: navigate the robot to a specified xyt goal pose in world coordinates
execute_trajectory: execute a multi-step trajectory by navigating the robot through a list of waypoints
get_base_pose: get the latest base pose of the robot from sensors as xyt or matrix
wait_for_waypoint: wait until the robot has reached a target waypoint within position and rotation thresholds
set_velocity: set the linear and angular velocity of the robot base directly
